summary:
All 22 frames were re-captured independently (sig prefix `v-medallions-`, shots `.vicifull/shots/v-med-*`, 46 signatures, 50 PNGs) and every one was driven to successfully — the recipes in `.vicifull/recipes/medallions.json` are accurate and reproducible. I also read every PNG and ran a whole-image pixel diff (`.vicifull/v-pxdiff.mjs`, status bar excluded) rather than trusting signatures, because `.vicifull/mdiff.mjs` forgives `background`/`border-radius`/`shadow` on *any* row where the app side is bare — which is exactly what a lost background also looks like.

The implementation is genuinely strong. The nine `Tiers *` pages are pixel-identical to the canvas (mean abs delta 0.57–0.70 / 255, zero pixels over 32); `Medallions` is 0.35; `Medallions Still To Earn` 0.55; the five `Breakwater *` boards 0.57–1.41 apart from the noise issue below. Every string, type metric, colour, box and rung on the nine ladders and the five Breakwater boards matches character for character. Navigation is real: the detail pill opens `/medallions/tiers/<key>` (verified for an earned metal, an unearned face, and a one-off → `/medallions/tiers/once`), the album pushes the right `?tier=`, and `/milestones` is reachable from profile, dashboard and All. `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` on the five files both exit 0. There is no SVG trap: `KKMedallion`'s `<Svg>` is the only child of a plain `View`, no absolutely-positioned sibling, and the art is visibly present in every PNG.

Two defects survive that the implementing agent did not report, one of them affecting ten frames. Four further mismatches are real but were disclosed as decisions (D057, D062); I've listed them so the count is honest, and I've flagged one factual error in D057's stated evidence.

NEW DEFECT 1 — the detail screens' background grain is stretched instead of tiled, on all ten `Breakwater *` and `Detail *` frames. `src/app/medallions/[key].tsx:185` draws the noise with expo-image `contentFit="cover"`, which scales the 96×96 `noise-dark.png` to fill 393×852 (≈4× wide, ≈9× tall). The canvas states `background-image: url('noise-dark.png')`, which repeats at native size, and every other screen in the app uses the shared `<Grain>` component (`src/components/ui/Grain.tsx:17`, `resizeMode="repeat"`) — including `src/app/medallions/tiers/[key].tsx` and `src/app/(app)/milestones.tsx`, which is why those pages are clean and these ten are not. Side-by-side crops of the same 200×250pt region show fine 1px speckle on the design and soft blobs tens of points across on the app. It is invisible to the signature (no row carries a texture) and it is exactly the "clean signature, wrong art" failure this project was told to watch for.

NEW DEFECT 2 — `Album Earned II` cannot be reached at the canvas's position. Measured scroller: viewport 290→769 (h 479), scrollHeight 1015, max scrollTop 536; row 4's content offset is 555, so the grid bottoms out with Logbook/Pulse at y 309 and Black Box/Lessons at 494, where the canvas draws 290 and 475 — a uniform 19pt shortfall on every row and every coin (whole-image delta jumps to mean 6.11, 4.05% of pixels over 32). `src/app/(app)/milestones.tsx:239` sets `paddingBottom: tabBar + 24` = 107; 126 is required. Contrary to the implementing agent's note, the frame *does* state that number: `Album Earned II` leaves exactly 126pt between the last card's bottom edge (643) and the tab bar (769).

Verification-record inaccuracies worth correcting: (a) the claimed `mdiff --dy=19 → 0 differing` for `Album Earned II` does not reproduce — `--dy=19` shifts the header, rail and tab bar too, giving 26 missing / 3 differing; (b) D057 argues the five-rung model from "the `Medallions` album card for Vici was re-lined **this drop** from `Tier II · ×5` to `Tier I · ×5`", but all 22 medallions frames are byte-identical between `.vicifull/prev/Email-Login/` and `.vicifull/final/Email-Login/` (no fdiff files exist for any of them), so nothing was re-lined this drop. The five-rung reading is still the better one — two current frames (`Medallions`, `Tiers Vici`) against one (`Detail *`) — but the decision log's evidence should be fixed.

Cross-group, and broader than reported: the retired `Back on Deck` face's storage keys `tideline.post.backondeck.pending/delivered` survive in five files, not the two named — `src/app/medallion-post.tsx:47`, `src/app/(app)/_layout.tsx:14-15`, `src/app/mail.tsx:30`, `src/app/urge-log.tsx:446`, `src/components/urge/index.tsx:2618`. The report's claim that `medallion-post.tsx` still delivers "Back on Deck / Tier II · The Return" is now stale — that file has since been rewritten to read the face off `kkFace('vici')` and drops the eyebrow and chip, matching `Medallion Received`'s current cut. Minor dead code: `KKMedallion`'s `progress` prop (and the in-progress arc it draws, `src/components/keepsakes/Medallion.tsx:406-421`) is never passed by any caller.
